So thus Krishna tells Arjuna and of the existent there is no cessation, spirit soul always continues to exist, it will leave this body, enter another body. The spirit soul is reality and these external designations, please. Such personalities never exist. They are only dresses. Avinashi tu tadviddhi yena sarvam idam tatam. Vinasham avyayasyaasya na kashchit kartumarhati. Know that which pervades the entire body is indestructible. No one is able to destroy the imperishable soul. Antavantayime deha nityasyokta shareerinah. Anashino aprameyasya tasmad yudhyasva Bharata. Only the material body of the indestructible, immeasurable, and eternal living entity is subject to destruction. Therefore, fight, oh descendant of Bharat. Ya enam vetti hantaram, yashchayanam manyate hatam. Ubhau tau na vijanito, nayam hanti na hanyate. He who thinks that the living entity is the slayer or that he is slain does not understand. One who is in knowledge knows that the self slays not nor is slain. Na jayate mriyate va kadachin. Nayam bhutva bhavita va na bhuyah. Ajo nitya shashvato yam purano. Na hanyate hanyamane shareere. For the soul there is never birth nor death, nor having once been does he ever cease to be. He is unborn, eternal, ever existing, undying and primeval. He is not slain when the body is slain. Veda vinashinam nityam ya enam ajamavyayam. Katham sa purushah Partha kam ghatayati hanti kam? Oh Parth, how can a person who knows that the soul is indestructible, Unborn, eternal, and immutable, kill anyone or cause anyone to kill. Vasansi jeernani yatha vihaya navani grihanti naroparani. Tatha shareerani vihay jeernani anyani sanyati navani dehi. As a person puts on new garments, giving up old ones, similarly the soul accepts new material bodies, giving up the old and useless ones. Nayanam chhindanti shastraani, nayanam dahati pavakah. Nachayanam kledayantyapo, na shoshiyati marutah. The soul can never be cut into pieces by any weapon, nor can he be burned by fire, nor moistened by water, nor withered by the wind. Achhedyoyam adayoyam akledyoshoshya evacha nitya sarvagatasthanur achaloyam sanatanah This individual soul is unbreakable and insoluble and can neither be burned nor dried. He is everlasting, all pervading, unchangeable, immovable, and eternally the same. So, sometimes people experiment to find out about the soul, this consciousness which animates the body.
